title: poterium stenolophum
intro: Poterium stenolophum, commonly known as the Chinese burnet, is a flowering plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to help reduce inflammation, relieve menstrual cramps, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Poterium stenolophum include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
